data.subject: PCYO Filing and Research Pilot
data.body:
Hi,

I’m writing because Peapod Lane Capital’s most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in PCYO and ALCO.

On August 25, 2026, PCYO disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465926100607/pcyo-20260824x8k.htm).

Local Ledger publishes independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can offer the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot.

Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
